evidence_summary: Commit 664614e adds only two data artifacts (a 2-record user corpus and its computed import positions); no code, no test, no report. Independent recomputation: loaded real base embeddings (1000x768) and the product's paraphrase-multilingual-mpnet-base-v2 model, encoded both test texts, and computed k-NN (k=5) centroids for the 'baseline' representation. Recomputed centroids (test_product_001=(3.0470,2.1139); test_product_002=(4.6161,3.1416)) match committed values within the documented per-coordinate jitter (std 0.01), confirming the artifact is genuine pipeline output, not fabricated. Committed user_corpus.jsonl loads via CorpusLoader.load_user_imports (user_import_count=2, both decisions present); imported_positions.jsonl is structurally consistent (60 lines, 30 reps x 2 decisions). Existing test_corpus_import passes (no regression). DEFECTS: (1) cycle is code-zero with no guarding test and no report; (2) imported_positions.jsonl is nondeterministic runtime state (jitter + append-only) that diverges on every rerun — confirmed by an uncommitted regeneration left in the producer working tree where all 60 coordinates shifted — so the committed snapshot is not reproducible and creates permanent git-dirty state; (3) mild churn (prior cycle 33978163967 removed these same files with a test; this cycle re-adds without one). No benchmark weakening, no negative-result deletion, no prettiness-as-quality. Genuine but thin and repairable -> REVISE, not BLOCKED.
